messages:
anya: Dropping a quick design note: we need a "compact ramp + sim" card for autofallback policies. Goal: let operators preview traffic/risk without touching routing.
cole: love that. main ask: the sim must run against a sliding-window of recent requests so we don't under/overestimate. 2h default window?
meera: 2h is ok but make window configurable. also include a toggle 'simulate with quotas' vs 'simulate ignoring quotas' for bench tests.
lina: disagree on the second toggle for production UI. we should only simulate honoring quotas by default and allow bench mode behind an engineer-only flag.
anya: fair. UX idea: card shows three microcards horizontally: Projected Traffic %, Estimated Cost Delta, Failure Delta. small sparkline for each.
cole: add a fourth microcard: "Fallback Fanout" listing where requests will go (model, cached, dedicated pool).
meera: alert on "Quota breach risk" if projected token usage crosses threshold. should be a yellow pill with exact token delta.
ops-bot: Simulation run: policy=fb-ramp-2026, snapshot_id=sim-3899999991-1, status=complete, sampled_requests=10k
anya: nice. how about the policy compact YAML we render inline? keeps devs happy. example: 
```
trigger:
  - name: high_5xx
    type: error_rate
    threshold: 4%
    window: 2m
fallback:
  target: safe-llm-quant-v2
  traffic_cap: 40%
  allow_dedicated_tier: false
audit:
  sample_rate: 0.5%
```
cole: when previewing, show a confidence band for the estimated traffic (p10-p90). avoid absolute numbers that seem exact.
meera: we also need an "operator override" affordance: a timeboxed manual fallback button. It logs operator id, reason, and auto-expires.
lina: minor security ask: overrides should require SSO groups and an MFA confirm if hitting prod pools.
ops-bot: Override logged: user=cole, reason="prod spike", ttl=15m, event=ev-20260318-ovr-01
anya: playback idea: lightweight trace for sampled events: click a timeline marker to open request/response diff (redact tokens like emails).
cole: add an "explain" link per trigger event that points to the simulated causal factors (latency distribution, codepoints, backend errors).
meera: telemetry owner note: make sure we store the sim inputs and outputs for 14 days for debugging. store redacted payloads only.
lina: also expose an API endpoint so infra tests can call the sim programmatically: POST /simulate-fallback with route, window, and sample_size.
anya: last UX thing: when enabling the policy live we show a small preflight modal with projected cost and an explicit checkbox "I accept potential cost delta". keep it annoying enough. :grimacing:
cole: can we add a quick link to revert the last policy change for 5 minutes? instant rollback = lifesaver.
meera: agreed. auto-rollback if unexpected error spike > 2x baseline for 5m after change.
ops-bot: Canary rollout: fb-ramp-2026 started at 5% across region-us-east1, id=fb-20260318-09
anya: ok i'll mock the card and API contract. tagging follow-ups in the ticket.
lina: thanks 10; I'll add SSO+MFA notes to the security checklist.
